title: Uniform ten-spin Lorentzian obstructions for cycle clique blowups
author: Lluis Eriksson

recommendation.qualification: Minor expository and packaging improvements recommended; no material mathematical correction required.
recommendation.basis: Proof chain, exact certificate reproduction and new checks support the theorem as stated. No unresolved material mathematical objection or counterexample found.

technical_quality.basis: Careful quantifiers, ordered limits, a complete symbolic-plus-finite argument and strong exact inspectability; no formal verification or certified reviewer independence.

airr_research_importance.basis: A substantive uniform-state extension to odd-cycle clique blowups, beyond the preceding stability hypothesis; specialized scope, inherited transfer method, no general source classification or optimality theorem.

correctness_confidence.basis: No gap found after exact reproduction, new enumerations and alternate inertia calculations. Software is not formally verified; prior model participation limits independence.

rigor_and_completeness.basis: Complete coverage of large s, bounded s tails, exceptions and k=2; correct compression and quantifiers. Central exact algebra is an integral supplementary part.

novelty_relative_to_checked_sources.basis: New odd-cycle uniform-state extension relative to primary sources and predecessor passages actually checked. Compression and even case are inherited. Exhaustive worldwide priority not checked.

significance_if_correct.basis: Useful infinite-family progress and a uniform finite-state obstruction. General conjecture, unequal blowups, sharp state bound and uniform parameter bounds remain open.

reproducibility_and_inspectability.basis: Hashes, exact data and readable reconstruction code; recommended verifier passes, with failed trials retained. Rating is not a claim of independent reviewers.
